3. RENT AND PAYMENT
The monthly rent for the Premises shall be Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand Only), payable on or before the 5th day of each calendar month. The rent shall be paid via bank
what_it_means_for_you: The landlord can unilaterally hike rent by up to 20% on renewal at sole discretion.
risk_reasons: Unilateral rent increase up to 20% upon renewal at landlord's sole discretion without tenant's consent.
A late payment fee of Rs. 500/- per day is charged for delays.
questions_to_ask: Can we cap renewal rent increase to 5-10% based on market rate?
evidence_quote: increase the rent by up to 20% upon renewal of this Agreement, at the Landlord's sole discretion, without requiring the Tenant's consent.
